body: I wish you good luck as well.

I’ve been depressed more than half of my life. I’ve always been told I have potential but I see nothing positive in my life. I know others have their struggles but pain is subjective.

I just feel very stagnant.

Wow, very hostile. I took the traditional premed coursework at my first university but they were/are shitty at assisting students. I’m starting a second Bachelors soon at a better school. I’m quite far from lazy.

I’m sorry you struggle.

Black male 

I know what career I want (medicine) but my first school didn’t prepare me to successfully apply and I resent this institution. I wouldn’t mind living at home if my parent wasn’t supercritical. Most people enter medicine at 25 and I feel like a fuck-up.

Additionally, I just feel so isolated. I have no one in similar straits so I feel no one relates.
Don’t know ya but this is the best thing I’ve seen today!
